decisions.reason: The cutting and creasing finisher sits in the firm's core postpress range, and with the industry growing and performance near aspiration there is no shortfall that would trigger search for other uses of its resources.

UV spot varnishing is distant from the core offer and its results are still uncertain, but the high-profile German premiere and growing turnover give enough slack to carry it while it builds a market.
The sheet preparation module builds on the established modular systems and supports the move toward automated workflows, so dropping it would release few resources and is unlikely.
The B2 multifinisher was prominently launched on the home page and fits the strategic push into automated digital finishing, so it likely meets aspirations.
The hybrid saddle stitcher is close to the core booklet-making business and complements consumables and service revenue, so there is no reason to remove it.
The folding add-on has a documented customer installation that enables inline one-pass production, a sign of results meeting aspiration.
